entry.name: abl.dsp.meldfilter~

attributes.name: type
attributes.digest: Filter type

choices.label: The DFM low-pass filter which feeds back more of its distortion internally.
A filter that has both pre and post distortion stages: a hard diode clipper on the input and a soft saturation on the output.
A modal resonator tuned to the first 32 modes of a circular membrane. The size, resonance, and high frequency damping of the membrane can be altered.
A peak filter with gain and width.
A notch filter with gain and width.
A six stage delayless inverted-feedback phaser with variable feedback and notch spacing.
A modal resonator tuned to the first 32 modes of a rectangular plate. The size, resonance, and dimension-ratio of the plate can be altered.
A resampler and bitcrusher with variable samplerate, quantization, and control over the amount of resampling artifacts.
A 12dB per octave state variable filter which can morph through these configurations: low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, notch.
A 24dB per octave state variable filter which can morph through these configurations: low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, notch.
A low-pass filter where resistors are replaced with fast switches to create downsampling artifacts.
A formant filter with vowel characteristics.
